edges: Osbert de Bayeux was supported by Archbishop Theobald of Canterbury in his attempts to switch the trial to an ecclesiastical court.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Osbert de Bayeux acted as a steward for Hugh de Tilly.
Osbert de Bayeux supported Henry Murdac as a rival to William fitzHerbert.
Osbert de Bayeux attempted to prevent the return of William fitzHerbert as Archbishop after Murdac's death.
Osbert de Bayeux had a son named William de Bayeux.
A hearing on the murder charges against Osbert was presided over by King Stephen of England.
Osbert de Bayeux is the nephew of Thurstan, the Archbishop of York.
Osbert de Bayeux appeared before Pope Adrian IV during his trial.
Osbert de Bayeux had a son named Turstin de Baius.
Osbert de Bayeux appeared before Pope Alexander III during his trial.
